select sd.id, sd.parent_id, sd.name, sd.type, sd.parent_key, sd.key, sd.value, sd.status, sd.sys, sd.sort, sd.remark, sd.create_time from sys_dict sd
join (select id from sys_dict where `key` = #{key} and del_flag = false) tmp on sd.id = tmp.id OR find_in_set(tmp.id, sd.ancestors)
where del_flag = false
and sd.level <= #{level}

select sd.id, sd.parent_id, sd.name, sd.type, sd.parent_key, sd.key, sd.value, sd.sort from sys_dict sd
join (select id from sys_dict where `key` = #{key} and status = 0 and del_flag = false) tmp on sd.id = tmp.id OR find_in_set(tmp.id, sd.ancestors)
where sd.status = 0 and del_flag = false
and sd.level <= #{level}
